query: FROM sales SHOW orders, total_sales GROUP BY billing_country ORDER BY total_sales DESC LIMIT 25 SINCE -30d UNTIL today WITH TIMEZONE 'Africa/Cairo'
note: billing_country IS a valid dimension in this shop — no fallback to sales_channel or product_type was needed. File name retains the requested 'sales_by_channel_30d' label but the grouping dimension is billing_country.
